ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the line ${l}_{1}: y={k}_{1}x+b$ and the line ${l}_{2}: y={k}_{2}x$, with their graphs depicted in the same Cartesian coordinate system as illustrated. What is the solution set for the inequality regarding $x$, ${k}_{1}x+b>{k}_{2}x>0$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given the graph, when $-1<x<0$, it follows that $k_1x+b>k_2x>0$,\\
hence the solution set for $k_1x+b>k_2x>0$ is $-1<x<0$.\\
Therefore, the answer is: \boxed{-1<x<0}.
